name: @posthog/integration-service
description: PostHog integration service — serves platform integration credentials over HTTP
author: PostHog Inc.

scripts.dev: tsx scripts/dev-integration-service.ts | pino-pretty --colorize --ignore pid,hostname --messageKey event --translateTime SYS:HH:MM:ss.l
scripts.fix: pnpm lint:fix; s=$?; pnpm format && exit $s

//aws-sdk-pins: Exact pins, not ranges. The AWS SDK ships its clients in lockstep against a matching @smithy/* tree; a floating range let client-secrets-manager drift ahead of the rest of the monorepo and the bundle failed on missing @smithy/core exports. Bump all three together.
